text: After this you can describe what an effective support-performance framework contains.

For education only; this is not legal, purchasing, financial or safety advice. Stage E turns a preferred delivery pattern into measurable accountability. Specify outcomes, owners, metrics, review periods, data quality checks and escalation routes. A statement such as “provide excellent support” cannot be managed without an observable standard. Use enough measures to guide decisions, but avoid tracking numbers that do not change action.

items: Inferred: Measure usable units at a fixed interval. Assign a reviewer and state what happens when the result misses the target.

text: Tie significant outcomes to both a metric and a responsible party.
An excessive set of measures can create administration without improving decisions.
